text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kyodo News Hai—a trial race for the spring Classics.
A vital race to test everything built up throughout the Junior year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps because of that,
Duramente's drive was tremendous...
And during our final training before the race—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In other words, leaving all others in the dust.
An overwhelming, vivid victory that pulls away from everyone—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—The strongest.
No other word can possibly be given.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Insisting on pulling away from the pack means giving it your absolute all right up to the very end.
That approach puts an immense strain on the body.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that way of running is what she truly desires,
I want to let her see it through.
However, keeping things as they are poses too great a concern...
choice_data_list: (In that case, in the Kyodo News Hai—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Running while calming myself down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her current running is certainly overwhelming, but...
it also looks like she simply can't
keep her own emotions under control.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...That might be true.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ever since I was a kid, whenever it comes to racing, I just can't help but get fired up.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That is why I devoted myself to mental training as well, striving to master my self-control, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Right now, the Classic Triple Crown races are drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I must run as befits the strongest.
Thinking of that, naturally, power wells up..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when aiming for that ideal, overwhelming run,
leaving it entirely to instinct is no different from running wild.
In that case, what I should focus on today is—
choice_data_list: Let's train your mental strength so you can keep yourself in check.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I can control how I run,
I should be able to reduce the strain on my body.
And bring my pursuit of the 'strongest' running style closer to perfection."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll give it a try.
choice_data_list: Let's run a race that leads to the future!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Watch me.
...See whether I can really pull this off.
